claims.label: Private meeting with Erika and Justin Streif lasted 4 hours 30 minutes
claims.claim: A private meeting between Candace Owens, Erika Kolfage, and Justin Streif, with George present at the opening and cousin Mia in attendance, lasted approximately 4 hours and 30 minutes.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify meeting date, location, and stated duration against any third-party records.

claims.label: Erika confirmed possession of Charlie's phone
claims.claim: Erika Kolfage confirmed she has Charlie Kirk's phone and that he primarily used Signal and Telegram for communications.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify Charlie Kirk's actual messaging platforms through device forensics.

claims.label: Erika confirmed Andrew Kolvet received pre-incident text
claims.claim: Erika Kolfage acknowledged that Andrew Kolvet received a pre-incident message from Charlie Kirk stating "they're going to kill me."
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the original message from Andrew Kolvet or his device records.

claims.label: Erika stated Dan Flood's pre-incident text specified "the left"
claims.claim: Erika Kolfage stated that the message Dan Flood received from Charlie Kirk the night before read "the left is going to kill me."
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain original Dan Flood message through his records or testimony.

claims.label: TPUSA case lawyer stated evidence base is at affidavit stage only
claims.claim: The lawyer involved in the Tyler Robinson prosecution told Candace that they have nothing beyond the affidavit-stage evidence and will not have access to further evidence until the May probable cause hearing.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the May probable cause hearing date through Utah court records; compare against public charging documents.

claims.label: Probable cause hearing scheduled for May
claims.claim: The probable cause hearing at which evidence will first be presented to a judge is scheduled for May 2026.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm hearing date through Utah state court docket.

claims.label: Candace spoke with witness who filmed rooftop person at 12:23 pm
claims.claim: Candace Owens spoke with a witness who filmed a person on the roof at 12:23 pm and did not see that person take the shot.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the witness and verify the video and timestamp.

claims.label: Witness described smaller gun, black tactical gear, no recoil
claims.claim: The rooftop-filming witness described the subject as wearing black tactical gear, carrying a smaller gun, and exhibiting no recoil.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify witness testimony through investigators and recorded statement.

claims.label: Mikey McCoy's first call was to wife Elizabeth McCoy
claims.claim: Mikey McCoy's call logs show his first post-shooting call was to his wife Elizabeth McCoy and lasted approximately 10 minutes.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the call logs directly from Mikey McCoy or from phone carrier records.

claims.label: Mikey three-wayed Erika 3 minutes after shot and father 2 minutes later
claims.claim: Mikey McCoy added Erika to the call approximately 3 minutes after the shot and added his father Rob McCoy approximately 2 minutes later, remaining on the phone with his wife throughout.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the three-way call sequence against carrier records.

claims.label: Mikey McCoy's real first name is Michael
claims.claim: Mikey McCoy's real first name is Michael; "Mikey" is not a middle-name substitute.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify against official identity records.

claims.label: Blake Neff's account contradicts the call logs
claims.claim: Blake Neff's interview account — that Mikey's first call after the shooting was to Erika, followed by his mother and father — directly contradicts the call logs provided by TPUSA.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference Blake Neff's recorded statement against the verified call sequence.

claims.label: Elizabeth McCoy was removed from public narrative despite memorial/vacation visibility
claims.claim: Elizabeth McCoy was reportedly involved in memorial activity and vacation travel with Erika, yet was removed from the publicly circulated version of the post-shooting call sequence.
claims.investigative_direction: Investigate the editorial decisions that excluded Elizabeth McCoy from circulated accounts.

claims.label: Three sources corroborated Bibi Netanyahu funding offer
claims.claim: Three sources with knowledge confirmed to Candace that Bibi Netanyahu offered to fund TPUSA to the next level and that Charlie Kirk turned down the offer.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the three sources and obtain documentary evidence of the offer.

claims.label: Andrew Kolb told Candace Bibi offered to take TPUSA to next level
claims.claim: Andrew Kolb (as named in transcript) told Candace verbatim that Bibi Netanyahu offered to take Turning Point USA to the next level and Charlie turned the money down.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify Andrew Kolb's specific statement; clarify whether this is the same person as Andrew Kolvet.

claims.label: Rob McCoy does not work for TPUSA in any capacity
claims.claim: Rob McCoy does not work with TPUSA in any capacity, contrary to his public conduct at the memorial and his claimed "America's pastor" status.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify Rob McCoy's formal affiliations independently of his self-presentation.

claims.label: TPUSA defended Terrell Farnsworth's camera removal
claims.claim: TPUSA defended Terrell Farnsworth's removal of cameras as part of a new livestream system used selectively for tour stops rather than all outdoor events.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify TPUSA's documented livestream policy and Farnsworth's specific authority on incident day.

claims.label: Andrew Kolvet posted surgeon "man of steel" bullet description
claims.claim: Andrew Kolvet posted a tweet attributing to a surgeon the claim that Charlie Kirk's bone density was so healthy he was "like the man of steel" and the bullet should have passed through.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the original tweet content and the surgeon's identity.

claims.label: Andrew Kolvet admitted surgeon did not know he would post
claims.claim: Per Candace, Andrew Kolvet acknowledged that the surgeon did not know he would write the tweet.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify Kolvet's stated communication with the surgeon and HIPAA implications.

claims.label: Tim Pool previously said Candace has no security
claims.claim: Approximately one week prior, Tim Pool stated Candace Owens had no security beyond one guard and a 4-foot wall at a suburban residence.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the earlier Tim Pool statement against his show archive.

claims.label: Tim Pool now claims Candace uses same security as Charlie Kirk
claims.claim: Tim Pool currently states Candace Owens has used the same security personnel and security companies as Charlie and Erika Kirk.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the current claim against any documented security employment records.

claims.label: Candace used different security from the start via Shafer Security
claims.claim: Candace Owens retained separate security from Charlie Kirk's from the beginning; Charlie's initial security was Shafer Security, operated by Greg Shafer, employing Dan Flood and Brian Harpole.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify Greg Shafer's public statement and Shafer Security's documented client list.

claims.label: No cease and desist received from Charlie's security
claims.claim: Candace has received no cease and desist from Charlie Kirk's security apparatus over security-related claims.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm absence of legal correspondence through counsel records.

claims.label: New York Post alleged Candace threw car keys at Daily Wire producer
claims.claim: New York Post article reported an anonymous source claim that Candace threw her car keys at a Daily Wire producer in her first week.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the cited Daily Wire source and article publication date.

claims.label: Candace never drove her car to Daily Wire
claims.claim: Candace Owens states she never drove her car to the Daily Wire during her tenure; she had a driver.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify against Daily Wire security logs or contemporaneous records.

claims.label: Candace's husband has no Qatari passport/citizenship
claims.claim: Per Candace, her husband does not have a Qatari passport and has not flown to Qatar.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify travel and passport records.

claims.label: Turkey Tom authenticated Robinson Discord chat messaging style
claims.claim: Turkey Tom produced a video asserting that he was in Discord chats with Tyler Robinson and that the published message style is authentic.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify Turkey Tom's claimed Discord membership through chat logs or other participants.

claims.label: George Zin allegedly told nurses he was paid to pose as shooter
claims.claim: Per Candace, George Zin told nurses at Utah Valley (where he was treated) that he was paid to claim to be the shooter.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify through hospital records, nurse testimony, or police interview of Zin.

claims.label: Kash Patel allegedly angry at Gabbard and Kent over terrorist-angle probe
claims.claim: Per Candace, Kash Patel expressed anger at Tulsi Gabbard and Joe Kent for investigating a potential terrorist angle to the Kirk case.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify through any on-record statements from the named individuals.

claims.label: Erika confirmed Charlie was attending mass and reportedly planning conversion
claims.claim: Erika Kolfage confirmed Charlie Kirk was attending mass; per third-party information relayed to Candace, he was reportedly planning to begin the Catholic conversion process.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify through parish records and direct corroboration from Erika on the record.

claims.label: Hampton retreat involved Seth Dillon confronting Charlie over hypothetical anti-Netanyahu tweet
claims.claim: Seth Dillon pressed Charlie Kirk at the Hampton retreat over a hypothetical tweet against Bibi Netanyahu, producing a heated moment.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify through any recording or attendee corroboration of the retreat.

claims.label: Andrew Seifer identified as TPUSA head of field
claims.claim: On the Charlie Kirk Show, Andrew Seifer was identified as TPUSA's head of field.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify Andrew Seifer's official TPUSA title.

claims.label: Charlie Kirk Show segment asserted August 27 had full location
claims.claim: On the Charlie Kirk Show, a speaker stated that TPUSA had posted the UVU courtyard location on its website as early as August 27.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the specific August 27 post referenced.

claims.label: Candace identifies September 2 KAMYU as first public location mention
claims.claim: Per Candace's timeline research, the earliest public mention of the UVU courtyard location was on KAMYU local media on September 2.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify KAMYU broadcast date and content.

claims.label: TPUSA/UVU/BYU August 27 graphic had no location details
claims.claim: Per Candace, the August 27 TPUSA/UVU/BYU chapter graphic announcing the event contained no location details.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the original August 27 graphic.

claims.label: Charlie Kirk direct quotation on asking questions
claims.claim: Candace reads a direct Charlie Kirk quotation: "You better keep asking questions, because it's the only thing that keeps us free."
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the quotation against the cited Charlie Kirk source.
